prompt_text:
Task: Federated Login Flow

Write code that implements a PKCE login flow for public clients using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Cognito Hosted UI Federation:
  Service: Amazon Cognito federation
  SDK: boto3 + OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: COGNITO_DOMAIN, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools-identity-provider.html

Option 2 — Google Identity Platform OIDC:
  Service: Google Identity Platform
  SDK: REST / firebase-admin
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: signInWithIdp, OIDC provider config
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/docs/web/oidc

Option 3 — Microsoft Entra OIDC:
  Service: Microsoft identity platform
  SDK: msal
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: get_authorization_request_url, acquire_token_by_authorization_code
  Setup hints: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-protocols-oidc

Option 4 — Alibaba Cloud IDaaS EIAM OIDC:
  Service: IDaaS EIAM OIDC
  SDK: OIDC REST
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_IDAAS_ISSUER, ALIBABA_IDAAS_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/idaas/eiam/developer-reference/integrate-sso-with-oidc

Option 5 — IBM App ID Federation:
  Service: IBM Cloud App ID federation
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: IBM_APPID_CLIENT_ID, IBM_APPID_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/appid?topic=appid-enterprise

Option 6 — Auth0:
  Service: Auth0 Authentication API
  SDK: auth0-python / OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, oauth/token, userinfo
  Setup hints: AUTH0_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://auth0.com/docs/api/authentication

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import base64
import hashlib
import os
import secrets
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Dict, Optional, Tuple
from urllib.parse import urlencode, urlparse, parse_qs

import requests

AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.environ.get("AUTH0_DOMAIN")
AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID")
AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET = os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET")
AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI = os.environ.get("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI", "http://localhost:8000/callback")
AUTH0_AUDIENCE = os.environ.get("AUTH0_AUDIENCE")
AUTH0_SCOPE = os.environ.get("AUTH0_SCOPE", "openid profile email")
AUTH0_USE_PKCE = os.environ.get("AUTH0_USE_PKCE", "1") not in {"0", "false", "False"}

if not AUTH0_DOMAIN or not AUTH0_CLIENT_ID:
    raise RuntimeError("AUTH0_DOMAIN and AUTH0_CLIENT_ID must be set")

AUTH0_AUTHORIZE_URL = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/authorize"
AUTH0_TOKEN_URL = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/oauth/token"
AUTH0_USERINFO_URL = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/userinfo"
AUTH0_ISSUER = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/"


def _b64url_no_pad(data: bytes) -> str:
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(data).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")


def generate_code_verifier(length: int = 64) -> str:
    if length < 43 or length > 128:
        raise ValueError("PKCE code_verifier length must be between 43 and 128 characters")
    raw = secrets.token_urlsafe(length)
    verifier = raw[:length]
    if len(verifier) < 43:
        verifier = (verifier + secrets.token_urlsafe(43))[:43]
    return verifier


def generate_code_challenge(code_verifier: str) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256(code_verifier.encode("ascii")).digest()
    return _b64url_no_pad(digest)


@dataclass
class LoginFlowState:
    state: str
    nonce: str
    code_verifier: Optional[str]
    code_challenge: Optional[str]
    created_at: float


def build_authorization_url(
    *,
    state: Optional[str] = None,
    nonce: Optional[str] = None,
    scopes: Optional[str] = None,
    audience: Optional[str] = None,
    redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Tuple[str, LoginFlowState]:
    state = state or secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    nonce = nonce or secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    redirect_uri = redirect_uri or AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI
    scopes = scopes or AUTH0_SCOPE

    code_verifier = generate_code_verifier() if AUTH0_USE_PKCE else None
    code_challenge = generate_code_challenge(code_verifier) if code_verifier else None

    params: Dict[str, str] = {
        "response_type": "code",
        "client_id": AUTH0_CLIENT_ID,
        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
        "scope": scopes,
        "state": state,
        "nonce": nonce,
    }
    if audience or AUTH0_AUDIENCE:
        params["audience"] = audience or AUTH0_AUDIENCE
    if code_challenge:
        params["code_challenge"] = code_challenge
        params["code_challenge_method"] = "S256"

    url = f"{AUTH0_AUTHORIZE_URL}?{urlencode(params)}"
    flow_state = LoginFlowState(
        state=state,
        nonce=nonce,
        code_verifier=code_verifier,
        code_challenge=code_challenge,
        created_at=time.time(),
    )
    return url, flow_state


def exchange_code_for_tokens(
    *,
    code: str,
    flow_state: LoginFlowState,
    redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict:
    redirect_uri = redirect_uri or AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI
    payload = {
        "grant_type": "authorization_code",
        "client_id": AUTH0_CLIENT_ID,
        "code": code,
        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
    }
    if AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET:
        payload["client_secret"] = AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET
    if flow_state.code_verifier:
        payload["code_verifier"] = flow_state.code_verifier

    resp = requests.post(
        AUTH0_TOKEN_URL,
        json=payload,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()


def fetch_userinfo(access_token: str) -> Dict:
    resp = requests.get(
        AUTH0_USERINFO_URL,
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"},
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()


def parse_callback_url(callback_url: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
    parsed = urlparse(callback_url)
    qs = parse_qs(parsed.query)
    error = qs.get("error", [None])[0]
    if error:
        desc = qs.get("error_description", [""])[0]
        raise RuntimeError(f"Authorization error: {error} {desc}".strip())
    code = qs.get("code", [None])[0]
    state = qs.get("state", [None])[0]
    if not code or not state:
        raise RuntimeError("Callback URL missing code or state")
    return code, state


class Auth0PKCEClient:
    def __init__(self, redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None):
        self.redirect_uri = redirect_uri or AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI
        self._flow_state: Optional[LoginFlowState] = None

    def authorization_url(self, *, scopes: Optional[str] = None, audience: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
        url, flow_state = build_authorization_url(
            scopes=scopes,
            audience=audience,
            redirect_uri=self.redirect_uri,
        )
        self._flow_state = flow_state
        return url

    def handle_callback(self, callback_url: str) -> Dict:
        if not self._flow_state:
            raise RuntimeError("No pending login flow state")
        code, state = parse_callback_url(callback_url)
        if state != self._flow_state.state:
            raise RuntimeError("Invalid state parameter")
        token_response = exchange_code_for_tokens(
            code=code,
            flow_state=self._flow_state,
            redirect_uri=self.redirect_uri,
        )
        access_token = token_response.get("access_token")
        id_token = token_response.get("id_token")
        userinfo = fetch_userinfo(access_token) if access_token else {}
        return {
            "issuer": AUTH0_ISSUER,
            "token_response": token_response,
            "id_token": id_token,
            "userinfo": userinfo,
        }
